fix(table): a RichText title's own justify outranks titleJustify, as Rich's Text does (rich-table-qj6i.kpp)

Rich 9d8f9a3 Text.__rich_console__ takes self.justify or options.justify, so a
Text title or caption keeps its own justify. _renderTitle cleared it; it no
longer does. The overflow="ignore" clear stays: that title would run through
the frame. Bytes pinned in table.test.ts from Rich 9d8f9a3.

fix(progress): a given completed wins over advance in updateTask (rich-progress-tsna) (#347)

* fix(progress): a given completed wins over advance in updateTask, as Rich's update (rich-progress-tsna)

* fix(progress): an advance that overflows names the sum it refused, not completed (rich-progress-tsna)
